title: Anthropic Shares Tank After Huge IPO As the Nasdaq Erases 2026 Gains - Slashdot

content_html: U.S. stocks extended their sell-off Friday as Anthropic shares plunged more than 11% on their second day of trading, despite the AI company's record-setting IPO a day earlier. The Nasdaq fell more than 3%, wiping out its gains for 2026, while the S&P 500 dropped nearly 2% and joined the Dow in correction territory, down at least 10% from recent highs. NBC News reports: The S&P 500 was trading nearly 2% lower as it headed for its worst losing week since April 2025, when President Donald Trump announced his "Liberation Day" tariffs, and is now 10% off from its most recent high, entering what's known as "correction territory." Meanwhile, the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite was off more than 3% and officially erasing all its previous gains in 2026. Other major AI-related names such as CoreWeave, Nvidia and Oracle also sold off. The six consecutive declining S&P 500 sessions mark the index's longest losing streak since April 2024. A seventh losing day would make it the longest stretch since the pandemic slump in February 2020, according to Deutsche Bank.
